title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: Entry Requirements by Tier
content:
This card sets out, for every tier of the Savings & Money Market Accounts family, what a customer must bring in order to hold a new account of that tier: the size of the first deposit, any Personal Checking relationship the tier insists on, the age band, and how many accounts of that one tier a single customer may keep open.

## Figures in force

| Tier | Smallest first deposit that activates the account (USD) | Personal Checking tier already required | Youngest age to open as sole owner | Oldest age to open | Most open accounts of this tier per customer |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Savings | 25.00 | none | 18 | no maximum | 2 |
| Statement Savings | 100.00 | none | 18 | no maximum | 3 |
| Goal Builder Savings | 50.00 | none | 18 | no maximum | 5 |
| Money Market Account | 2500.00 | none | 18 | no maximum | 2 |
| Premier Money Market | 10000.00 | none | 18 | no maximum | 2 |
| Private Client Money Market | 25000.00 | an active Private Client Checking account | 18 | no maximum | 2 |

## How to read each column

- **First deposit.** An amount in US dollars. The first credit to reach a newly opened account has to be at least this figure for the account to become usable.
- **Personal Checking tier.** Either the word none or the names of one or more Personal Checking tiers. Where a name appears, only a customer who at that point has an active account of that checking tier qualifies.
- **Age band.** Whole years of age on the opening date. The youngest figure is the lowest age at which the customer may be the only owner; no tier sets an upper age.
- **Accounts of this tier.** A count of accounts of the same tier the customer may have open at one time.

## What each tier demands of a new owner

Every tier tests three things: the customer's age reaches the tier's youngest age, the first deposit reaches the tier's smallest first deposit, and the customer's count of accounts of that tier sits below the tier's maximum. Private Client Money Market adds a fourth: the customer holds one of the listed Personal Checking tiers.

## Points of judgement

**Does the oldest-age column ever stop an application?** No. Each tier records no maximum, so age can only bar a customer who is too young.

**Does the per-tier maximum count accounts held in other tiers?** No. It counts only open accounts of the tier being applied for; a hypothetical customer holding four Goal Builder Savings accounts is still below that tier's figure of five, whatever else they hold.

**Is a Private Client Checking account needed for Premier Money Market?** No; only Private Client Money Market lists a checking tier.
